scripts.load:seed: node -e "if(!process.env.SEED_DATABASE_URL){console.error('load:seed: set SEED_DATABASE_URL to a dedicated load-test database (never the shared lokacia DB) — see docs/OPERATIONS.md');process.exit(1)}" && DATABASE_URL=$SEED_DATABASE_URL pnpm --filter @lokacia/db migrate && DATABASE_URL=$SEED_DATABASE_URL SEED_LISTINGS=${SEED_LISTINGS:-50000} pnpm --filter @lokacia/db seed
scripts.demo:beta: node -e "if(!process.env.SEED_DATABASE_URL){console.error('demo:beta: set SEED_DATABASE_URL to a dedicated beta/demo database');process.exit(1)}" && DATABASE_URL=$SEED_DATABASE_URL pnpm --filter @lokacia/db migrate && DATABASE_URL=$SEED_DATABASE_URL SEED_BROKERS=${SEED_BROKERS:-50} SEED_LISTINGS=${SEED_LISTINGS:-400} pnpm --filter @lokacia/db seed
